invariants.statement: Concurrency verification harness validating atomic compare-and-swap operations, tagged pointer ABA immunity, and deterministic thread interleavings for concurrency targets.
Deterministic schedule sequentializer permutes all valid task interleavings up to bounded depth K with zero lost updates and complete deadlocks detection.
64-bit packed atomic tagged pointer guarantees 100% fail-closed rejection of stale version tag updates under simulated ABA mutation trials.
Distributed storage engine enforces strict monotonic fencing tokens (t_fence > t_last) and rejects 100% of stale out-of-order writes.
